name: benmi-android-pos
description: Benmi Multi-Tenant Universal Android POS Tablet App with Remote Cloud Loader & Thermal Printing

scripts.sync: bash build.sh && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:prod: APP_ENV=prod bash build.sh && APP_ENV=prod npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:dev: APP_ENV=dev-local bash build.sh && APP_ENV=dev-local npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:pilot: APP_ENV=pilot bash build.sh && APP_ENV=pilot npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:local: APP_ENV=local bash build.sh && APP_ENV=local npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: export APP_ENV=prod && bash build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:dev: export APP_ENV=dev-local && bash build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:pilot: export APP_ENV=pilot && bash build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:local: export APP_ENV=local && bash build.sh && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
